summary: SunCar Technology Group Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K with the SEC, incorporating its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the fiscal half-year ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses operational and legal updates, including a Chinese court ruling that reduced Shanghai Zanxing's equity interest in SunCar Online to 47.92% from 55.34%, effective June 30, 2026, following litigation initiated by Shanghai Yongyuan Venture Capital. Despite the reduction, SunCar asserts effective control via concerted action agreements holding 50.97% and states the judgment remains unenforced. This is an ordinary periodic report, not a special situation.
